about.desc: I'm Mehmet KURU — a full-stack engineer, designer, and strategist. Since 2013, I've been building software for solo founders, VC-backed startups, and small-to-medium businesses. mehmetkuru.dev operates with one senior lead per project, a tight collaborator network, and a focus on delivery over slide decks. From DevOps infrastructure to UI/UX design, SEO to mobile apps — end-to-end solutions.
about.v1Desc: We write code the way a cabinetmaker joins wood — cleanly, honestly, and to last.
about.v2Desc: You will always hear what we actually think. Scope, budgets, tradeoffs — no theatre.
about.v3Desc: A working Friday build every week. Feedback compounds when it lands early.
about.v4Desc: We ship. Then we watch it in production and iterate. Handoffs are not launches.
about.v5Desc: Every project is delivered on time, within budget, and to our quality standards. Client satisfaction is our priority.
